findings.code: dt = 2e-4 and n_substeps = int(2e-3 / dt); static arithmetic gives 10 substeps and a nominal 2e-3 code-time step.
findings.interpretation: Suggests a mismatch in the paper substep duration, not proof of the intended paper setting; physical time-unit mapping is not established by this audit.

findings.code: Pouring places MILK below WATER; defaults are RHO[MILK]=0.5 and RHO[WATER]=1.0. Body initialization uses RHO[material].
findings.interpretation: Different density defaults/order from the paper table; retain both versions and investigate exact experiment provenance.

findings.paper: Section 4.1 says non-Newtonian; Table 4 labels pouring materials Liquid with mu=0.
findings.code: WATER and MILK map to MAT_LIQUID; MU=0.0 and LAMDA=277.78 for both.
findings.interpretation: Code supports the table class/mu description, but does not resolve all source wording or identify the exact experimental configuration.

findings.interpretation: Supports the observation-budget interpretation; does not mean only 500 particles were simulated.
